# Shaders components

<!-- Generated by packages/shaders/scripts/generateSkillDocs.ts from the shader registry. Do not edit. -->

Every component in the `shaders` package (199). "Needs input" marks an effect: it transforms the layers drawn before it (siblings above it, or children nested inside it when it should affect only those). The rest draw on their own.

Props, defaults and ranges: `https://shaders.com/docs/components/<Name>` (send `Accept: text/markdown`).

## Textures

- **Aurora**: Mesmerizing aurora borealis with layered curtains, vertical rays, and flowing light.
- **Beam**: A beam of light from one point to another.
- **Blob**: Organic animated blob with 3D lighting and gradients
- **BlockNoise**: Blocky value noise with soft cells that morph over time
- **BlueNoise**: High-frequency blue noise — even, grainy speckle ideal for dithering
- **BrickPattern**: Classic brick wall pattern with alternating rows and mortar gaps
- **Checkerboard**: Classic checkerboard pattern with two alternating colors
- **Chevron**: Animated chevron / zigzag stripe pattern
- **ColorWheel**: A directional gradient that smoothly cycles through rainbow colors or a custom set of three colors
- **ConicGradient**: Colors sweep in a full circle around a center point, like a color wheel
- **CurlNoise**: Swirling divergence-free flow field that drifts over time
- **DiamondGradient**: Diamond-shaped gradient radiating from a center point using Manhattan distance
- **DotGrid**: Grid of dots with optional twinkling animation
- **ErosionNoise**: Branching, hydraulic-erosion ridges carved into noise
- **FallingLines**: Directional falling lines with a leading-to-trailing color fade
- **FloatingParticles**: Drifting, twinkling motes — thousands of real simulated particles floating in a shared heading with per-particle wander and variance, and a cursor that stirs the field with a gust that settles back into the drift
- **FlowingGradient**: Liquid silk gradient with organic flowing color bands
- **FractalNoise**: Multi-octave fractal Brownian motion noise texture with true noise evolution
- **GaborNoise**: Oriented sine-grain noise with a fingerprint-like flow
- **Godrays**: Volumetric light rays emanating from a point
- **Grid**: Simple grid lines pattern with adjustable thickness and rotation
- **HexGrid**: Honeycomb hexagonal grid pattern
- **HTMLInCanvas**: Render live HTML/DOM content as a WebGPU texture layer via the html-in-canvas API. Requires Chrome Canary with chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element enabled.
- **ImageTexture**: Display an image with customizable object-fit modes
- **IsometricCubes**: Isometric tumbling-blocks tiling — a 3D cube illusion (rhombille pattern)
- **LinearGradient**: Create smooth linear color gradients
- **Marble**: Classic marble swirl and vein texture using noise-warped sine waves
- **MeshGradient**: Flowing mesh gradient of soft drifting color swaths whose seams wrap through the palette
- **MultiPointGradient**: Five individually placed color points blended together by proximity — drag each point to shape the gradient
- **PerlinNoise**: Smooth gradient noise that morphs over time
- **Plasma**: Animated effect of glowing plasma
- **Prism**: A beam of light that fans out and splits into a slowly-rotating rainbow past a controllable point. Transparent background — composite over a dark layer.
- **RadialGradient**: Radial gradient radiating from a center point
- **Ripples**: Concentric animated ripples emanating from a point
- **Scratches**: Fine hairline scratches, like a worn film or scratched surface
- **SimplexNoise**: Organic noise with animated movement
- **SineWave**: Animated wave with thickness and softness
- **SolidColor**: Fill the canvas with a single solid color
- **Spiral**: Rotating spiral pattern with animated movement
- **Strands**: Flowing ribbons of light with a multi-color gradient
- **Stripes**: Alternating colored stripes with animation
- **StudioBackground**: Multi-light studio background with ambient motion.
- **SunBurst**: Radial sunburst rays emanating from a center point
- **Swirl**: Flowing swirl pattern with multi-layered noise
- **Text**: Text with any Google font — multi-line with wrapping, alignment and line height — rendered crisp via a glyph texture
- **TriangularGrid**: Tiling grid of equilateral triangles with optional animated row offsets
- **Truchet**: Quarter-circle arc tiles that connect to form organic, maze-like flowing curves
- **VideoTexture**: Display a video with customizable playback and object-fit modes
- **Voronoi**: Cellular pattern where each pixel is colored by its distance to the nearest of many scattered points
- **Waveform**: Audio-visualizer waveform — equalizer bars, a filled wave, an oscilloscope line, or a dot matrix — driven by a simulated signal whose amplitude you can map to your own audio level
- **WaveletNoise**: Rotating banded wavelets that ripple as they animate
- **Weave**: Interlaced textile weave pattern with two thread colors going over and under each other
- **WebcamTexture**: Display a live webcam feed with customizable object-fit modes
- **WorleyNoise**: Cellular noise field — distance-based, with selectable feature combinations and fractal octaves

## Shapes

- **Arc**: Pie sector (arc wedge) with adjustable radius and aperture angle
- **Circle**: Generate a circle with adjustable size and softness
- **Crescent**: Crescent moon shape — an outer circle with an inner circle subtracted
- **Cross**: Plus / cross shape with adjustable arm length, width, and rounding
- **Ellipse**: Ellipse with independently adjustable horizontal and vertical radii
- **Flower**: Petal shape with N lobes and adjustable inner-to-outer radius ratio
- **Heart**: Heart shape with adjustable size
- **Line**: Draw a straight line between two points with color, thickness, and solid, dashed, or dotted styles
- **Parallelogram**: Parallelogram with adjustable width, height and skew
- **Polygon**: Regular polygon with adjustable sides and corner rounding
- **Ring**: Annular ring (donut) with adjustable radius and band thickness
- **RoundedRect**: Rounded rectangle with adjustable width, height, and corner rounding
- **Star**: Classic star polygon with straight sides and sharp pointed tips
- **Teardrop**: Teardrop — a rounded bulb tapering to a sharp point
- **Trapezoid**: Trapezoid with adjustable top and bottom widths and height
- **Vesica**: Vesica piscis (lens shape) formed by the intersection of two overlapping circles

## Shape Effects

- **BrushedMetal**: Photorealistic brushed metal — a satin anodised surface combed with fine directional grain that smears the reflected studio and key light into the long anisotropic streaks of real brushed aluminium, steel, gold or copper
- **CarbonFiber**: Photorealistic woven carbon fibre — interlaced tows whose anisotropic sheen flips ninety degrees cell to cell, raised into a quilted weave and finished with a glossy clearcoat that mirrors the studio. Plain or twill, in any shape.
- **Chrome**: Studio-lit mirror chrome — a precision-machined shape with a controllable polished bevel, softly convex faces and a photographic studio reflected in them: one huge frontal softbox, black flags, and thin warm/cool strip lights that fringe amber and ice-blue exactly where the reflections break
- **Crystal** (needs input): Diamond-like crystal lens with faceted refraction.
- **Emboss** (needs input): Embossed / debossed relief shading on top of child content, driven by a custom shape
- **Frost**: Photoreal frozen ice — thickness-driven subsurface scattering that reads as a solid block, with fine frost crystals creeping in from the edges
- **Glass** (needs input): Optically realistic glass lens driven in a custom shape
- **Goo**: Photoreal wet liquid — animated 3D metaball blobs that merge and bulge to loosely form the shape, with sliding wet highlights, a clearcoat rim and a translucent body
- **Heatmap**: Thermal-camera heat flowing through any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.
- **Hologram**: Volumetric sci-fi hologram — a translucent emissive projection of the shape with fresnel-lit edges, depth scan-lines that wrap 3D forms, CRT scanlines, flicker and beam wobble
- **Holographic**: Iridescent holographic foil sticker with animated rainbow sheen and glitter flakes
- **Irradiance**: Photorealistic light spilling around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape — any number of movable colored point lights strike the silhouette and the lit edges irradiate their surroundings, gathered in a compute pass with real cast shadows, mixing where they meet and burning to white at the rim
- **LightEdge**: Glowing, pulsing light racing around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.
- **LiquidMetal**: Flowing liquid chrome — a molten reflective surface that wraps the shape, sweeping a procedural studio reflection across animated folds with crisp speculars and prismatic edges
- **Nebula**: A volumetric gas nebula sealed inside polished glass; billowing emission clouds with hollow dark cavities and hot glowing cores, star fields drifting at real depth behind the gas, all refracted through the curved walls of the shape and dressed with studio reflections
- **Neon**: Photorealistic neon tube / 3D pipe effect driven by a custom shape
- **Obsidian**: Dark tinted glass whose faces stay near-black while every surface turning away from the viewer ignites with a flowing iridescent gradient — vivid color living only on the oblique walls and bevels
- **Particles**: A swarm of simulated particles that settles into the shape, filling it evenly — flat, SVG or true 3D volumes — scattering from the cursor (or chasing it), tumbling when the shape moves, and always drifting back home
- **Plastic**: Glossy molded plastic with photorealistic studio reflections, driven in a custom shape
- **SmokeFill**: Fill a shape with swirling fluid smoke that interacts with the shape boundary
- **ThinFilm**: Iridescent thin-film edge
- **Voxels**: Rebuild any shape out of voxels — a flat shape becomes chunky pixel art, a 3D shape a lit voxel model with smooth ambient occlusion, cast shadows, a key light you can orbit or drive, and per-cube color
- **Water**: Translucent water — a refractive, light-absorbing body that deepens to its color with thickness, wrapped in a wind-driven wave surface that reflects a procedural sky, with Fresnel-bright grazing edges and foam breaking on the crests and shoreline

## Blurs

- **AngularBlur** (needs input): Radial motion blur rotating around a center point
- **Blur** (needs input): A simple Gaussian blur effect
- **BokehBlur** (needs input): Photographic lens blur where bright highlights bloom into aperture-shaped discs
- **ChannelBlur** (needs input): Independent blur for red, green, and blue channels
- **DiffuseBlur** (needs input): Grain-like pixel displacement at random
- **LinearBlur** (needs input): Directional motion blur in a specific angle
- **ProgressiveBlur** (needs input): Blur that increases progressively in one direction
- **TiltShift** (needs input): Selective focus blur mimicking tilt-shift photography
- **ZoomBlur** (needs input): Radial zoom blur expanding from a center point

## Distortions

- **BarShift** (needs input): Slices content into parallel bars, each offset independently for a fractured or glitch-like effect
- **Bend** (needs input): Bends the ends of the frame toward you like a curved display — content at the edges swells closer under real perspective, or curls away when the strength goes negative
- **Bulge** (needs input): Magnify or pinch content around a center point
- **ConcentricSpin** (needs input): Concentric rings that each rotate the underlying image by different amounts
- **CornerPin** (needs input): Pin each corner of the content to an arbitrary position for a free perspective warp
- **DisplacementMap** (needs input): Distorts child content using another layer's pixels as a displacement map
- **Flip** (needs input): Mirror content horizontally, vertically, or both
- **FlowField** (needs input): Fluid-like distortion with constant smooth motion
- **FlutedGlass** (needs input): Full-screen fluted glass effect — refracts content through repeating cylindrical bars
- **Form3D** (needs input): Wraps child content onto a 3D raymarched shape with lighting.
- **GlassTiles** (needs input): Refraction-like distortion in a tile grid pattern
- **Kaleidoscope** (needs input): Create a kaleidoscope effect with radial mirrored segments
- **Mirror** (needs input): Mirror content across a line defined by center point and angle
- **Perspective** (needs input): Rotate the plane in 3D space with pan and tilt
- **PolarCoordinates** (needs input): Convert rectangular coordinates to polar space
- **RectangularCoordinates** (needs input): Convert polar coordinates back to rectangular space
- **Repeater** (needs input): Repeat the child content in grid, radial or linear layouts with per-instance variation
- **Spherize** (needs input): Map content onto a 3D sphere surface with depth distortion
- **Stretch** (needs input): Stretch content towards a direction from a center point
- **Surface3D** (needs input): Drapes child content over a 3D wave surface with perspective and lighting
- **Twirl** (needs input): Rotate and twist content around a center point
- **WaveDistortion** (needs input): Wave-based distortion with multiple waveform types

## Adjustments

- **BrightnessContrast** (needs input): Adjust brightness and contrast of the image
- **Duotone** (needs input): Map colors to two tones based on luminance
- **Exposure** (needs input): Multiplicative exposure (gain) on the child. Unlike additive brightness, it scales values around black — blacks stay black while highlights can be pushed past 1.0 to feed HDR bloom and tone-mapping roll-off. Pointwise, so no extra render pass is needed.
- **FilmStock** (needs input): Real analog film color from measured film-emulation LUTs — ten classic stock looks with emulsion halation and projector gate weave
- **Grayscale** (needs input): Convert colors to black and white
- **HueShift** (needs input): Rotate hue around the color wheel
- **Invert** (needs input): Invert RGB colors while preserving alpha
- **Posterize** (needs input): Reduce color depth to create a poster effect
- **Saturation** (needs input): Adjust color saturation intensity
- **Sharpness** (needs input): Adjust image sharpness using a convolution kernel
- **Solarize** (needs input): Inverts tones above a luminance threshold — a classic darkroom and photo effect
- **Tint** (needs input): Apply a color tint to the image
- **Tritone** (needs input): Map colors to three tones: shadows, midtones, highlights
- **Vibrance** (needs input): Selective saturation adjustment protecting skin tones

## Stylize

- **Ascii** (needs input): Convert imagery to ASCII character art
- **Chalkboard** (needs input): Renders content as a chalk drawing on a blackboard, with edge strokes and cross-hatch shading
- **ChromaticAberration** (needs input): Separate RGB channels for a prismatic distortion effect
- **CompressionArtifacts** (needs input): Simulates lossy JPEG compression — 8×8 DCT block quantization, blockiness, ringing and color bleed
- **ContourLines** (needs input): Draw topographical contour lines based on luminance or alpha
- **CRTScreen** (needs input): Retro CRT monitor simulation with scanlines
- **DataMosh** (needs input): Corrupted-codec motion smearing — macroblocks lock in place and drag their pixels across the frame in liquid trails, each recovering on its own clock, like a video stream that lost its keyframes
- **Dither** (needs input): Dithering effect with multiple pattern options
- **DropShadow** (needs input): Adds a soft shadow behind the child content based on its alpha silhouette
- **Engraving** (needs input): Copper-plate line engraving — the image is redrawn as flowing line work whose weight swells with darkness, lines displaced by the form like a banknote portrait: a single plate, cross-hatched shadow plates, or one continuous spiral cut
- **FilmGrain** (needs input): Analog film grain texture overlay, weighted toward darker areas
- **Glitch** (needs input): Digital glitch that melts pixels and distorts colors
- **Glow** (needs input): Soft glow effect with adjustable intensity
- **GradientMap** (needs input): Maps source luminance through an animated color gradient (Photoshop-style gradient map)
- **Halftone** (needs input): Halftone dot pattern effect for printing aesthetics
- **KeyFrames** (needs input): Motion-tracking overlay — trackers hunt and follow features in the content, dropping keyframe diamonds behind them along their motion paths, like a compositor mid-track
- **LensDistortion** (needs input): Split content into shifting chromatic layers with barrel or pincushion lens warp. Powered by Paper Shaders.
- **LensFlare**: Realistic camera lens flare with artifacts.
- **LightLeak** (needs input): Photorealistic film light leak — warm overexposed light bleeding in from a draggable anchor point, with streak bands, chromatic fringing, and slow breathing that evolves over time
- **ObjectTracker** (needs input): Computer-vision style object detection overlay — draws bounding boxes and labels around detected regions of the content below, with grid, quadtree and mosaic layouts.
- **Paper** (needs input): Applies realistic paper grain and surface roughness to child content
- **ParticleField** (needs input): Explodes the child content into a breathing 3D field of particles — bright areas float toward you and dark areas recede, the whole relief can be orbited with the camera rotations, and the cursor physically throws particles that spring back home
- **Pixelate** (needs input): Pixelation effect with adjustable cell size
- **ReflectivePlane** (needs input): Reflective floor that mirrors the content above it
- **Sparkle** (needs input): Twinkling star glints over the bright parts of the layer inside
- **Stone** (needs input): Applies a marbled stone relief and surface distortion to child content
- **TimeTrail** (needs input): An Echo-style temporal trail — whatever moves sheds a smooth, decaying long-exposure ghost trail (frame-difference Motion mode works on opaque images and video; Alpha mode trails a shape's coverage), with optional zoom-feedback tunnels and rainbow light-painting
- **VHS** (needs input): Analog VHS tape with intermittent tape damage, chroma bleed, and per-scanline noise
- **Vignette** (needs input): Darkens or tints the edges of the frame, drawing attention toward the center
- **Watercolor** (needs input): Painterly watercolor look — Kuwahara flattening, pigment edge darkening, paper grain and bleeding
- **Wool** (needs input): Applies an interwoven fibrous fabric texture and distortion to child content

## Interactive

- **Boids**: A living murmuration of hundreds of flocking agents drawn as crisp arrows, streaks, dots or glowing comets — separation, alignment and cohesion drive fluid, splitting-and-merging ribbons, agents flash toward an excited color when scattered, and the cursor acts as an attractor or a predator
- **ChromaFlow**: Interactive liquid flow effect that follows your cursor
- **CursorRipples** (needs input): Fluid-like ripple distortion
- **CursorTrail**: Animated trail effect that tracks cursor movement
- **Fog**: Fog that fills the screen and interacts with the mouse
- **GridDistortion** (needs input): Interactive grid distortion controlled by mouse position
- **InkFlow**: Drag to paint swirling ribbons of ink through a real fluid field — eddies keep evolving after you let go
- **Liquify** (needs input): Liquid-like interactive deformation effect
- **MagneticFilings**: Thousands of tiny iron filings scattered on paper that swing to align with a magnetic field around the cursor, tracing out the field lines — a dipole whose axis follows the cursor's motion draws the classic two-lobed swirl, and every sweep of the magnet sends a glowing wave of filings flipping and settling
- **ParticleFlow**: Thousands of drifting dust particles carried by a real incompressible fluid field the cursor stirs — drag to plow a wake and the particles ride the eddies and vortices it leaves behind, while a gentle ambient breeze keeps the whole scene breathing on its own
- **PixelSort** (needs input): Pixels sort by brightness around the cursor and keep their sorted position, optionally decaying back over time
- **PixelThrow** (needs input): Throws pixels along the cursor's path like a fluid — brighter (or redder/greener/bluer) pixels are flung farther, then settle back with friction
- **ReactionDiffusion**: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion pattern that fills the layer and blooms wherever you drag the cursor
- **Shatter** (needs input): Broken glass effect with tectonic plate displacement
- **Smoke**: Realistic fluid smoke simulation with vorticity dynamics
- **SmokeFlow**: Cursor-driven smoke that lingers, swirls, and dissipates with fluid dynamics

## Transitions

- **BarnDoors** (needs input): Split the content along a center line and wipe outward in both directions
- **BlockDissolve** (needs input): Dissolve the content away as a grid of blocks vanishing in random order
- **CheckerWipe** (needs input): Wipe the content away as a checkerboard of fading squares
- **DiamondWipe** (needs input): Wipe the content away through a lattice of growing diamonds
- **IrisWipe** (needs input): Reveal through an expanding circle growing from a center point
- **LinearWipe** (needs input): Wipe the content away along a straight edge with a soft feathered transition
- **NoiseDissolve** (needs input): Dissolve the content away through an organic noise pattern
- **PagePeel** (needs input): Curl the content up from a corner like a peeling page
- **RadialWipe** (needs input): Sweep the content away in a clock-hand arc around a center point
- **RandomBars** (needs input): Wipe the content away as parallel bars vanishing in random order
- **RippleWipe** (needs input): Wipe the content away in concentric rings pulsing out from a center point
- **SliceWipe** (needs input): Slice the content into strips that slide away in alternating directions
- **VenetianBlinds** (needs input): Wipe the content away behind a set of parallel closing strips

## Utilities

- **Group** (needs input): Container for organizing and composing child effects — supports flex-like flow layout (column/row stacking via the flow prop)
